verdict.rationale: Navan's official API retrieves and updates card transactions and manual expenses, with batch PATCH updates, custom-field and option-value management, and per-transaction activity history. That lets an agent pull transactions and push coding back. Its hosted MCP server lets agents query spend and see why transactions were flagged and which policy applies, which supports proposing policy flags. missing for 10: an explicit 'uncoded' transaction filter, evidence that MCP supports write-back rather than only querying, a documented review/staging step for agent-pushed coding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
